name: gmp-logistics-and-routing-static-vanilla-js
description: Fleet Telematics, Road-Snapped GPS & Dispatch Dashboard using Static HTML + Vanilla ES Modules and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { const req = ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','server.mjs','.env.example','README.md','AGENTS.md']; for (const f of req) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing required file: ' + f); } console.log('Build check passed: all static assets and syntax verified.'); })"
